# Polka

Polka is a colorful, minimal theme in light and dark modes, with optional ribbon dots. Its UI colors follow Obsidian's accent color, while code blocks take an independent theme such as Dracula, Gruvbox, Nord or Solarized. Background palettes, fonts, checkbox shape and UI roundness are set through Style Settings.

![Polka screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/callumhackett/obsidian_polka_theme/HEAD/polka.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Polka"
    author: "callumhackett"

    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/callumhackett/obsidian_polka_theme/HEAD/polka.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply colorful minimalism in light and dark modes with optional ribbon dots. Sync UI colors to Obsidian's accent and select independent code-block themes like Dracula, Gruvbox, Nord or Solarized. Customize background palettes, fonts, checkbox shape and UI roundness via Style Settings."
}
```
